commands.cmd:
P="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promptfoo-0.123.1"
reg=$(timeout 30 npm view promptfoo@0.123.1 dist.integrity dist.tarball --json) || { echo "PROMPTFOO_INSTALL_FAIL: npm view failed"; exit 1; }
ls=$(timeout 30 npm ls --global --prefix "$P" --depth=0 2>&1)
onpath=$(readlink -f "$(command -v promptfoo)")
python3 - "$reg" "$P" "$ls" "$onpath" <<'PY'
import base64, glob, hashlib, io, json, os, sys, tarfile, urllib.request
reg, prefix, ls, onpath = json.loads(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4]
pinned_integrity = 'sha512-9WzFeH6L+5E49R6CTulBo/WzmVPNcMpvgUZAyEsNlaKgpfmF9vV82jKUG1rQ+QH79P7gYAaxeY3TvLDV+x0Cbg=='
stack = [c['version'] for c in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if c['id'] == 'promptfoo']
winners = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'promptfoo'})
data = urllib.request.urlopen(reg['dist.tarball'], timeout=60).read()
sri = 'sha512-' + base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha512(data).digest()).decode()
root = os.path.join(prefix, 'lib/node_modules/promptfoo')
members = [m for m in tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data)).getmembers() if m.isfile()]
tar = tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data))
same = sum(1 for m in members if open(os.path.join(root, m.name.split('/', 1)[1]), 'rb').read() == tar.extractfile(m).read()) if os.path.isdir(root) else 0
ok = (stack == ['0.123.1'] and winners == ['0.123.1'] and reg['dist.integrity'] == pinned_integrity == sri
      and members and same == len(members) and 'promptfoo@0.123.1' in ls and onpath.startswith(root + '/'))
print('PROMPTFOO_INSTALL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| stack', stack, 'winner', winners, '| registry tarball sha512 == dist.integrity == pinned integrity:', reg['dist.integrity'] == pinned_integrity == sri, '| installed files identical to the tarball:', same, 'of', len(members), '| npm ls tools/promptfoo-0.123.1:', 'promptfoo@0.123.1' in ls, '| promptfoo on PATH resolves into that prefix:', onpath.startswith(root + '/'))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT

v=$(PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR="$T/pf-home" PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 timeout 30 "$PF" --version) || { echo "PROMPTFOO_EVAL_FAIL: promptfoo --version did not run"; exit 1; }
[ "$v" = "0.123.1" ] || { echo "PROMPTFOO_EVAL_FAIL: promptfoo reports $v"; exit 1; }
cat > "$T/promptfooconfig.yaml" <<'YAMLCFG'
description: "native-agent-stack promptfoo use receipt: local llama.cpp Qwen3.8-27B eval"
providers:
  - id: openai:chat:qwen3.8-27b-local
    config:
      apiBaseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:18232/v1
      apiKeyEnvar: PF_LLAMA_KEY
      temperature: 0
      max_tokens: 32
      passthrough:
        chat_template_kwargs:
          enable_thinking: false
prompts:
  - "{{query}}"
tests:
  - vars: { query: "What is 2+2? Reply with only the digit, nothing else." }
    assert:
      - type: equals
        value: "4"
  - vars: { query: "Name the capital of France. Reply with just the city name, nothing else." }
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Paris"
  - vars: { query: "Is 7 a prime number? Reply with only yes or no." }
    assert:
      - type: javascript
        value: "/\\byes\\b/i.test(output)"
  - vars: { query: "Reply with exactly the single word: PONG" }
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "PONG"
  - description: "positive control: deliberately wrong assertion, must fail"
    vars: { query: "Reply with exactly the single word: PONG" }
    assert:
      - type: equals
        value: "DEFINITELY_WRONG_TOKEN_never_matches"
YAMLCFG
KF=$(timeout 10 systemctl --user show nativestack-generation.service -p ExecStart --value | grep -oP -- '--api-key-file\s+\K\S+')
[ -n "$KF" ] && [ -r "$KF" ] || { echo "PROMPTFOO_EVAL_FAIL: the generation service key file was not found"; exit 1; }
IFS= read -r PF_LLAMA_KEY < "$KF"
export PF_LLAMA_KEY
PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR="$T/pf-home" PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_UPDATE=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_REMOTE_GENERATION=1 PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_SHARING=1 timeout 540 "$PF" eval --config "$T/promptfooconfig.yaml" --no-cache --no-table --no-progress-bar --no-share --no-write --output "$T/results.json" -j 1 > "$T/stdout.log" 2> "$T/stderr.log"
EVAL_RC=$?
unset PF_LLAMA_KEY
python3 - "$T" "$EVAL_RC" "$A" "$KF" <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
from host_receipts import sanitize
from validate import scan_file_for_private_content
t, rc, dest, keyfile = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), Path(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4]
key = Path(keyfile).read_text().strip()
raw_path = Path(t, 'results.json')
if not raw_path.is_file() or raw_path.stat().st_size == 0:
    err = Path(t, 'stderr.log').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()[-5:]
    tail = sanitize('\n'.join(err).replace(key, '[redacted]') if key else '\n'.join(err)).replace(t, '<tmp>')
    key = None
    print('PROMPTFOO_EVAL_FAIL | no native results file | eval exit', rc)
    print(tail)
    sys.exit(1)
raw = raw_path.read_text()
text = sanitize(raw.replace(t, '<tmp>'))
key_absent = bool(key) and key not in raw and key not in text
key = None
report = json.loads(text)
body = (json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n').encode()
sha = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
Path(t, 'sanitized.json').write_bytes(body)
private = scan_file_for_private_content(Path(t, 'sanitized.json'))
emails = re.findall(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}', body.decode())
safe = key_absent and not private and not emails
stats = report['results']['stats']
rows = report['results']['results']
outputs = [r.get('response', {}).get('output') for r in rows]
passes = [bool(r.get('success')) for r in rows]
providers = {r.get('provider', {}).get('id') for r in rows}
requests = stats.get('incurredTokenUsage', stats['tokenUsage'])['numRequests']
ok = (rc == 100 and stats['successes'] == 4 and stats['failures'] == 1 and stats['errors'] == 0 and requests == 5
      and passes == [True, True, True, True, False] and outputs == ['4', 'Paris', 'yes', 'PONG', 'PONG']
      and providers == {'openai:chat:qwen3.8-27b-local'} and safe)
# The retained report is written once, by exclusive create, and never overwritten: a re-run compares instead.
if dest.exists():
    retained = 'exists, left unchanged, sha256 ' + ('equal' if hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sha else 'differs (a re-run has its own evalId and timestamps)')
elif safe:
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(dest, 'xb') as handle:
        handle.write(body)
    retained = 'created'
else:
    retained = 'not written (sanitization check failed)'
print('PROMPTFOO_EVAL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| eval exit', rc, '| successes', stats['successes'], 'failures', stats['failures'], 'errors', stats['errors'], '| live requests', requests, '| outputs', outputs, '| control row failed:', passes[-1] is False, '| key absent', key_absent, '| private/email findings', len(private), len(emails), '| sanitized report sha256', sha, '|', dest.name + ':', retained)
print('per-row pass', passes, '| providers', sorted(providers), '| promptfoo', report.get('metadata', {}).get('promptfooVersion'), '| retained path', dest.as_posix())
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
